items.source: which you do not understand: #{italic}#'Sho ch'zun Eyal mor donuth, ik ranaheli donoth trun ze.'#{normal}#
items.target: 即使你懂得这种语言，也无法理解：#{italic}#'Sho ch'zun Eyal mor donuth, ik ranaheli donoth trun ze.'#{normal}#

items.source:
The Creator. The God who made this world, He who watched silently as the races fought and burnt the land.
He who felt great sorrow for this world. He who shall now shatter the barriers of this world to remake it, only better!
The staff will allow us to drain enough energy from this world to open the portal to the Void and summon Him through!
You cannot stop us now!
items.target:
造物主，创造这个世界的神。他默默注视着各个种族争战不休，将大地付之一炬。
他为这个世界深感悲痛。如今他将击碎这个世界的屏障，将它重塑得更加美好！
这根法杖将让我们得以从这个世界抽取足够的能量，打开通往虚空的传送门并召唤他降临！
你现在已经无法阻止我们了！

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A slot in the door opens and a pair of wild eyes peer out.*#WHITE#
What do you want, @playerdescriptor.race@?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*门上开了一个小洞，一副狂乱的眼睛凝视着他。*#WHITE#
你想干什么，@playerdescriptor.race@？

items.source: Aeryn, are you well?
items.target: 艾琳，你还好么？

items.source: Thanks, my lady. I have not been able to find all of the orbs of command in my travels; could you have some of your men search for me?
items.target: 谢谢，我的女士。我没能找到所有的指令水晶球；请问你可以让你们的人来帮我寻找一下吗？

items.source: Number of items to make
items.target: 制作的物品数量

items.source: Excellent. Return in a few days, and I'll have everything prepared. Oh, take this. #LIGHT_GREEN#*He hands you a key*#WHITE# It opens the ruins of Telmur, which the men of Sholtar sealed many years ago. If you happen to find a text in the ruins entitled "Inverted and Reverted Probabilistic Fields," return with it and your odds of surviving our portal attempt will go up drastically.
items.target: 很好，几天后你回来，我肯定把一切都准备好了。哦，带上这个。#LIGHT_GREEN#*他交给你一把钥匙。*#WHITE#它可以打开泰尔玛废墟，那是多年前肖尔塔人封印的地方。要是你在废墟之中找到一份标题是《反转与复原概率场》的文献，请帮我带回来，这能大大提高你通过传送门时存活的几率。

items.source:
@playername@, you are called to serve. The nearby unhallowed morass inhabitants are growing restless.
You must go there and find the source.
items.target:
@playername@，你效力的时候到了。附近不洁沼泽中的居民正在蠢蠢欲动。
你必须去那里，找到这一切的源头。

items.source:
#{bold}#Relle, Cornac Fighter & Expedition Captain#{normal}#
Nothing but hatchlings so far. Honestly, if this keeps up we won't have enough dragonhide to cover a dragon, let alone cover our losses. I've really spared no expense this time as well: Gorran is one of the finest rangers I know, and Sodelost... his prices are exorbitant, but then what else would you expect from those money-grubbing dwarven Thronesmen? I must admit I don't know much about Xann. The locals say there's no finer wyrmic in the area, and I admit she is something special in combat. Now, if only she could turn her draconic talents to FINDING some dragons!
items.target:
#{bold}#探险队队长，科纳克人战士瑞丽#{normal}#
到目前为止从未遇上幼龙。老实说，照这样下去，我们得到的龙皮连一条龙都盖不住，更别说弥补损失了。这次我也确实不惜血本：高岚是我认识的最优秀的巡林客之一；至于苏达罗斯特……他的要价高得离谱，不过钢铁王座那群贪财的矮人还能是什么样？我得承认，自己并不了解希安。当地人说这一带没有比她更出色的龙战士，而她在战斗中确实不同凡响。现在只盼她能把操控龙族力量的本事用来找出几条龙！

items.target: 举报我的不良行为

items.target: 将物品丢弃到哪里？

items.target: 在“龙之贪婪”成就中积累3000金币。

items.target: 在30波模式中成为新的竞技场主宰。

items.source: I will not let you down!
items.target: 我一定会让你失望的！

items.source: Got to wave 50 in the arena.
items.target: 竞技场生存至第20轮。

items.source: Now, this is impressive!
items.target: 这个发现可真是令人印象深刻！

items.source: Achieved your wild dreams of power and eternal life: you turned into a Lich!
items.target: 成就你的野心并获得永恒的生命，你终于成为了巫妖！

items.source: Kickin' it old-school
items.target: 现代风格

items.source: Killed a boss while already dead.
items.target: 在已死亡的状态下杀死一个BOSS。

items.source: Stabilized the Abashed Expanse to maintain it in orbit.
items.target: 控制次元浮岛使其稳定在地面上。
